summary: APANA regional hub wa.apana.org.au ('Apana West'); main server Odyssey; defunct (AUSTRALIAN PUBLIC ACCESS NETWORK ASSOCIATION INC., ABN 84 081 355 722).

events.details: APANA regional structure; WA hub ('Apana West'); region linked from apana.org.au homepage by 12 Jul 1997; founding predates the archive and is unverified.

Regional nodes folded into the single National Region. Proposal's c. 2013 promoted over current c. 2023: the WA node site disappears from the record after Jul 2013 and its host no longer resolves. last WA node capture 27 Jul 2013; subdomain DNS now fails; APANA operates a single National Region.

refs.label: Last capture of the WA regional node site; probes for 2014 and 2016 both resolve to this Jul 2013 capture (nothing newer)
Live check 29 Sep 2026: national APANA survives but explicitly under a National Region structure — the regional-node model (incl. the WA node) is superseded; wa
